about: State of an item being destroyed that waits for its fade-out effect: added by bg3.exe+0x33CD8D0 (esv::item::DestructionSystem) with the effect name and a delay; handled by the Toolkit's `anonymous-namespace'::HandleWaitingForFadeOut (EoCServer.dll+0x141CB30, called from esv::item::DestructionSystem::Update), which counts the delay down, plays the effect with esv::EffectManager::PlayAndForgetEffect ("Can't play fade-out effect (%s) on item destruction: %s"), then counts the effect's duration down. Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (server row).

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x33D03A0 (AllocRaw 0x10, destructor bg3.exe+0x698FE0) stores the global FixedString at bg3.exe+0x61AABD0 with IncRef; writer bg3.exe+0x33CD8D0 assigns the FixedString at +0x48 of a resource looked up with type 7 (bg3.exe+0x412E090). Toolkit: passed as the effect name to esv::EffectManager::PlayAndForgetEffect and printed in the fade-out error.

Creator zeroes dword +4; writer copies the 4-byte value at +0x40 of its third argument. Toolkit HandleWaitingForFadeOut subtracts the frame's delta time from the float at +4 while it is > 0; the effect is played when it reaches 0.
Creator zeroes dword +8. Toolkit: set to the float at +0x20 of the effect after the effect is played, then decremented by the delta time; destruction proceeds when <= 0.
Creator zeroes dword +0xC then byte +0xC. Toolkit: the byte at +0xC is tested for zero and set to 1 once the fade-out effect has been played.
Zeroed by the creator's dword store, never used.
